inflate_positional_embeds: inflate temporal positional embeddings to match a different number of frames using bilinear interpolation or zeros
remap_keys: remap CLIP-style model state dict keys to TimeSformer-style keys for a given number of transformer layers
rgetattr: recursively get a nested attribute from an object using dot-separated attribute path strings
rsetattr: recursively set a nested attribute on an object using dot-separated attribute path strings
review_utils: review the lavila models utils module for positional embedding inflation and CLIP to TimeSformer key remapping functions
